# Security reporting

Report vulnerabilities through [GitHub's private reporting form](https://github.com/aiden-jang/owewell/security/advisories/new).
Include the affected feature, steps to reproduce, and potential impact. Use sample
data and remove credentials and personal information from examples and logs.

Keep vulnerability details in the private report while they are investigated.
Use public issues for ordinary bugs and feature requests.

Security fixes target the current main branch. Older revisions are not maintained
as separate release lines. Report issues against the latest code when possible.
